page: Amazon Web Services c8gn.8xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 processors utilizing the ARM64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at 2.8 GHz, with no hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a compute-optimized ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate top-tier memory bandwidth, with read-only large block speeds reaching 390.52 GB/sec and write speeds at 185.7 GB/sec. Multi-core processing is highly efficient, as evidenced by a top-tier Geekbench multi-core score of 21777.0 and strong software compilation performance. Database operations and Redis SET operations also perform in the top-tier and strong categories respectively, while LLM inference tasks on larger models show average to weak performance due to the lack of hardware acceleration.

The ARM64 architecture and dedicated core allocation provide high resource density and power efficiency, translating to qualitative cost advantages for sustained multi-threaded workloads. This server is optimized for network-heavy compute workloads, software compilation, database operations, high-throughput static web serving, and multi-threaded decompression tasks.
